BiblicalUsage: Once in each genealogy, a son of Shobal: the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The name is a Horite chief in the line of Seir, counted among the dukes of Edom, and the count is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A chief named twice in the lists carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the order of Edom, that the sons of Seir are named beside the sons of Esau.
